title.narrative: SUPPORTING DIALOGUE & SYSTEMS CHANGE FOR SD

description.narrative: 4SD is a Swiss-based social enterprise specialised in training and mentoring of development practitioners. The Foundation is committed to improving the skills of emerging and established leaders who operate within the food-climate-health nexus in line with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Supporting Dialogues and Systems Change for Sustainable Development DFA’s funding to 4SD will focus on the Supporting Dialogues and Systems Change for Sustainable Development initiative. The 4SD dialogue and systems change approach was initiated in 2018. It has evolved through an initial two-year development process (2018 – 20), followed by intensive use in the 2021 UN Food Systems Summit and the 2021 – 23 follow-up. The approach was used to prepare for both the July 2023 UN Food Systems stocktake and the 2023 – 25 UN Convergence Initiative. This links UN-led work on food systems transformation and the UAE-led COP28 declaration on sustainable agriculture, resilient food systems and climate action. The 4SD dialogue and systems change approach is now being used by governments, local authorities, researchers, indigenous peoples, civil society groups, farmer organizations, local authorities, youth groups, women's organisations, businesses, and international bodies. The objective of the present initiative is to build on these experiences and support convergence dialogues for the transformation of food systems through activities covering dialogue facilitation, training and capacity building, documentation and impact analysis.
